newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian crude, gas production up in January - EGP.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian crude, gas production up in January - EGP.

text.p: Egyptian crude oil production rose in January to an average of 845,000 barrels per day (bpd) from 832,000 bpd in December, the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) said on Tuesday.
Natural gas output also rose, to 1.33 billion cubic feet a day from 1.11 billion cubic feet a day in December.
Condensate production fell to 35,000 bpd from 35,800 bpd, while propane and butane output increased to 32,000 bpd from 31,600 bpd, EGPC said.
Overall hydrocarbon production during January was 36.51 million barrels of oil equivalent, of which 8.22 million came from natural gas, it said.
